note: Contacts head + provisioning: POST /contacts/provision creates an account (argon2id), an address book whose policy asks the `_contacts` stack before a client edit commits, and a hello card from card{}. The book is then readable by any CardDAV client on the web port under /carddav/ (Basic auth over plaintext in dev), and the `_contacts` stack refuses cards without an email address. Binds localhost → contacts-demo for the route and pony.local.thanks.computer (dev-local, auto-verified) as the domain the username must belong to. Needs `txco dev --contacts`.
